content:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected — prod/inference error spike (5xx) in us-west-2. alert: error_rate > 300/min. Paging @amelia (primary oncall).

amelia: ack — looking now. any customer-facing 5xx reports?

maria: seeing a lot of retries from mobile API, some timeouts reported in the 3p tenant group. not widespread 5xx but latency up.

liam: pulling Grafana, tailing logs. initial glance: burst of OOM/kv-cache-miss exceptions from model `redwood-quant-v2` instances. CPU+GPU queues saturated around 12:21 PDT.

sam: rolling a very small mitigation: temporary per-model qps cap and disable batching for `redwood-quant-v2` so we reduce concurrent GPU spike. applying now.

amelia: applying canary rollback to `redwood-quant-v1` on two nodes in us-west-2 to see if error rate drops. will update in 2m.

oncall-bot: Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/inference/kv-cache-eviction — follow section "fast mitigation". PD incident: INC-4582 created. PagerDuty escalation active.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-4582: escalation policy "Inference P0" notified oncall.

liam: update: after rollback + rate cap, error rate dropped from 320/min -> 18/min in 6 minutes. latency still elevated for long prompts. Looks like queue backlog clearing.

amelia: good. marking mitigation "canary-rollback + cap" as successful. opening a customer impact note: brief latency increases for large-context requests; a handful of enterprise customers saw timeouts and retried. sending CS an initial heads-up.

sam: created temporary alert suppression on slack channel for the specific firing alert to avoid duplicate noise while we stabilize. suppression window 10m.

maria: thanks — but we still got 40 identical slack messages for that alert before suppression took effect. we should reduce noise.

amelia: agreed. post-incident action items: tune alerting rules so we don't page on short bursts and dedupe identical alerts across hosts and zones. propose changes below.

liam: propose concrete alert tuning:
```yaml
alert: InferenceErrorRateHigh
expr: sum by(model, region)(rate(inference_errors_total[1m]))
for: 5m   # increase from 1m to 5m to avoid transient spikes
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "High inference error rate"
```
- group_by: [model, region] — group alerts so we don't get one page per host.
- add a `dedupe_key` on model+region in metrics pipeline so PD sees grouped alerts.

sam: on Slack side we can enable `rate_limit: 1/min` for this alert in the channel integration and collapse duplicate messages for the same dedupe_key. but that is sticky; longer-term we should fix at metrics/alert level.

maria: also add a circuit-breaker style alert: if error_count > 500 in 10m across cluster then page — catch broad systemic failures. keep grouped by service, not host.

amelia: decision checklist for immediate follow-ups:
- liam: implement `dedupe_key=model:region` in the alert rule and update Alertmanager config to group_by that key (owner: liam, ETA: 48h).
- sam: update Slack integration to collapse duplicate postings for that alert and set channel rate limit (owner: sam, ETA: 24h).
- sam: change PD escalation to require sustained firing of 3 consecutive 1m evaluations (effectively a 3m sustained window) before escalate (owner: sam, ETA: 24h).
- maria: create a new dashboard tile "Inference: error rate by model (grouped)" and add a latency percentiles panel for large-context requests (owner: maria, ETA: 72h).
- amelia: follow up with CS and affected customers with timeline and mitigation notes (owner: amelia, ETA: today EOD).

liam: implementation note: in Prometheus/Alertmanager we can add `group_by: ['dedupe_key']` and set `group_wait: 30s`, `group_interval: 5m`, `repeat_interval: 4h` to avoid noisy re-alerts. I'll include sample config in the PR.

sam: for PagerDuty we can set the dedup key to `{{ $labels.model }}:{{ $labels.region }}` and set `auto_resolve_timeout` appropriately. Also enable `suppress_notifications` for flapping alerts.

maria: small UX thing — add the runbook link and owner to the alert annotations so responders have quick context.

amelia: capturing longer-term items too:
- Investigate KV cache eviction pattern and optimize cache sizing / heap safety to stop future evictions. (eng-ml + eng-runtime)
- Evaluate smarter autoscale thresholds to prevent runaway queueing for heavy models.

sam: I'll open the PD config change PR and the Slack integration tweak after lunch.

liam: starting a metrics pipeline PR for dedupe_key now. will link in thread.

amelia: thanks team. closing PD incident once we confirm no more error spikes for 2 hours. leaving this thread open for post-incident notes. :thumbsup:

(oncall-bot: Incident INC-4582 marked mitigated by canary rollback + qps cap at 1745765620.)

amelia: post-incident note (summary): cause = kv-cache eviction + queue saturation on redwood-quant-v2; impact = elevated latency, some customer timeouts; mitigation = canary rollback to v1 + temporary per-model qps cap; follow-ups = dedupe/grouping/rate-limit for alerts, dashboard, runbook updates.

maria: adding final acceptance criteria: no PD pages for the same root cause for 14 days, and alert volume from this rule reduced by >= 80% in non-P0 events.

liam: linked PRs: https://git.internal/alerts/PR-827 (alertmanager grouping), https://git.internal/metrics/PR-912 (dedupe key).

sam: PD policy PR: https://git.internal/pagerduty/PR-44 — changes include escalation threshold and suppression settings.

amelia: assigning owners in the incident ticket and marking follow-ups. will run a 30m review tomorrow with eng-runtime, eng-ml, and SRE to validate fixes.

maria: thanks all. moving to post-incident review channel after this.
